overview: Netherbian Lair is the primary subterranean passage linking Norrath’s spires to Luclin’s Nexus.
history: Originally carved by Netherbian creatures, the tunnels became a major transit route after the Nexus activated. Arcane residue from transit misfires destabilizes deeper tunnels.
hooks: A transit misfire leaves arcane residue throughout the Pass.
Netherbian creatures swarm in unusual patterns.
A collapsed tunnel reveals ancient Luclin structures.
Shadow anomalies appear near the Depths.
Travelers report hearing voices echoing from unseen chambers.
